description: 岐阜市: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by 岐阜市. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. Coverage: Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed for this provider (Gifu, Gifu Prefecture, Japan). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Shapes, Translations. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. Note in the listing: 収録路線：加納地区「加納めぐりバス」、市橋地区「西ぎふ・くるくるバス」、日光地区「にっこりバス」、三輪地区「みわっこバス」、中心市街地東部地区「e（いい）バス」、芥見東・南地区「みどりっこバス」、黒野・西郷地区「ほっとバス」、藍川地区「あいあいバス」、長森南地区「373(みなみ)バス」、境川地区「境川らくちゃんバス」、 It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
